remarks: Welcome home to this oversized studio apartment offering an impressive amount of space and flexibility. The spacious layout provides plenty of room to create separate living, sleeping and dining areas, making it feel much larger than your typical studio. Enjoy an eat in kitchen, in unit laundry and plenty of closet space for convenient everyday storage.  Ideally located close to major highways, shopping, restaurants, medical facilities and everyday conveniences, this apartment offers an excellent combination of space, comfort and accessibility. A great opportunity for anyone looking for a generously sized studio in a convenient location. Schedule your showing today!
